law: Use this framework to offer an exceptionally large catalog of one-time purchases, subscriptions, and subscriptions with optional add-ons while using the App Store commerce system.
Apps that use this API host and manage their own catalog of In-App Purchases, or SKUs.
You can use the Advanced Commerce API and the StoreKit API in the same app.
Both APIs use the App Store commerce system, including the same signed JWS transactions and JWS renewal info.
Your server must support the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol 1.2 or later to call the Advanced Commerce API.
